adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, both `removeMember` and `addMembers` call `self.findMembers()` without adjusting `offset`. `findMembers()` clamps the request offset using the *current* `this.get("user_count")` (which is stale immediately after a remove), so it can request an offset that is now past the end. The server (`GroupsController#members`) will return an empty `members` array with `meta.total` updated, and the client then sets `user_count`/`offset` to those values—leaving the UI on an empty last page until the user navigates back. This is directly reproducible when removing the last member on the last page (e.g., total 51→50 with limit 50, offset stays 50, members become empty).
